issue.title: Narrow top-bar usage PNG tests time out in wait_for_startup on clean HEAD
issue.description:
Both narrow top-bar usage PNG tests fail on a clean HEAD worktree (55936f429, no local diff), reproduced twice (a focused 6-worker run and a full 13-worker `just fix-tui-screenshots` run), and the sase-17d.10.1 land agent recorded the same timeouts on both the cutover and no-cutover trees.

- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_provider_usage_indicator.py::test_top_bar_usage_attention_narrow_png_snapshot`
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_provider_usage_indicator_states.py::test_top_bar_usage_badges_crowded_narrow_png_snapshot`

Both time out in `wait_for_startup` at the narrow terminal size, so `fix-tui-screenshots` skips them after 3 attempts and the run ends `partial`, which also blocks stale-golden removal in a full update run.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails on every attempt: three recover attempts in the full lane, plus two independent clean-HEAD runs; same result on the cutover and no-cutover trees per the sase-17d.10.1 land agent. Companion node: tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_provider_usage_indicator_states.py::test_top_bar_usage_badges_crowded_narrow_png_snapshot.
